prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Create your custom companion", "Upload a photo or choose a pet reference image to ensure clear AI pet generation."]
1: ["Use your existing account to ensure your pet status and progress are preserved."]
2: ["Master Your Desktop Pet", "Swipe through quick cards to learn how to drag, hide, right-click, and chat with your pet anytime."]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "Your pet is getting ready. This usually takes around 2 to 3 minutes."]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Select whether you want to adopt a standard pet companion or generate a custom friend."]
5: ["Name & Finalize Your Adoption", "Give your new companion a memorable name before bringing them to your desktop."]
6: ["Starter Companion Pack Unlocked"]
7: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Signing in ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings are saved securely to your account."]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Meet your cute digital companion living directly on your desktop screen."]
9: ["You can safely minimize this window. We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready!"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions unlocked packs or free extras.
